fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is expanding quantum computing collaboration with PsiQuantum, IBM, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory, advancing commercialization in drug discovery and error correction.
fields.summary_ko.1: PsiQuantum is building hybrid quantum-high-performance computing using AMD Versal FPGA, Instinct GPU, EPYC CPU, and ROCm, advancing data center hardware capabilities.
fields.summary_ko.2: Based on AMD's fair value of $647, disclosure of quantum-related workloads in the data center segment will serve as a signal for commercial transition.
